storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Cyberpunk Story
storyTemplate.description: A cyberpunk start: wake in a rain-soaked alley with stolen data and decide how to survive the first trace.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Neon rain runs down your jacket and pools around a cracked data shard in your palm.

Somewhere above, Tower Seven's alarms sweep red across the alley walls. Your comm is dead, your fake badge is burning hot, and a corporate trace icon blinks on the shard's surface.

The data is valuable. So is getting out alive.
